required_composition: 정면 로고와 오른쪽 면이 함께 보이는 새 시점; projected front area >=40%, right area >=5% of visible product surface
fixed: Run19 source photos, frozen cuboid vertices, identical render_target/common code, lens correction, 1600x1067 resolution; no geometry refit
permitted_inputs: 6 source RGB, source annotations, frozen cuboid, official source/target camera metadata. No target RGB or target annotations before ranking freeze.

selection_rule.jacobian_sampling: homography source-to-target local Jacobian at 5x5 bilinear interior points per face; singular values; face weights from projected target area
selection_rule.meaning: uncalibrated geometric sampling-risk proxy; lower is preferred, not a probability or verified accuracy
selection_rule.tie_break: closest to baseline then smaller angle

evaluation: After ranking freeze, open all six fresh real views. Reuse Run19 corner/seam and logo correspondence evaluator; same seven visible corner IDs per view. Compare structural and surface errors separately with side-by-side images. Approximate 2-5px manual annotation uncertainty. Do not judge a slight metric difference as decisive.
gate: Proceed only for clear important-error improvement over baseline without worse core feature or violated composition, and no use-blocking defect. Ambiguous improvement=conditional/inconclusive. If best view still has use-blocking geometry, pivot renderer scope rather than tune selector.
known_data_exclusion: Run19 target views [30,90,150,210,270,330] were already inspected and are not new test evidence; existing observations informed this pilot, so this is not product-level generalization.
cost_scope: CPU and existing dependencies, no generative model or paid API. Quick pilot.
